chunks: And it is narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about fasting the Days of Tashrīq. He said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله prohibited fasting them only in Minā; as for elsewhere, there is no harm.”

key_terms.أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ: the Days of Tashrīq, specific days connected to the rites of hajj
key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Minā, the location where this ruling specifically applies
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.صِيَامِ: fasting as an act of worship
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is fasting during the Days of Tashrīq prohibited everywhere or only in Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning fasting on the Days of Tashrīq. It states that the prohibition applies specifically in Minā, while fasting on those days outside Minā is not problematic.
